payload: unchanged2x256B A register tiles; scale wrapper retains exactly12 shift bits; no new SRAM/data FIFO
problem: Old flush requires halted quiescence, including no active A use. A partial native M abort can stop accepting the remaining A operands, leaving old active permanently nonquiescent.
abort_valid_source: Only a full matching M ABORT frame accepted at real serial EOP, including session/record/full input key/full RF owner, verified by the bounded serial guard and resolved to the live A lease. This is not a host Boolean permission.
pending_use: A scheduled matching W use that has not yet started may also be invalidated; it never increments issued or completed
stream_cut: A valid matching verified ABORT offer under halt stops only its cancelled A stream while its lease remains live. This is the explicit receiver-abort protocol, not an ordinary withdrawal of a stalled ready/valid operand.
abort_ready: Requires exact identity, halt, real no-more-issue/transport-return drain and actual pending source-read drain. Before this handshake active ownership remains; invalid identity cannot cut a new generation.
abort_accept: Invalidate lease, clear only its active stream and scheduled W reference; never invent missing operand handshakes and never increment completed use count
FREE: Only later halt+quiescent flush, after held load receipts and source responses drain. INVALID and zero visible A valid are not FREE.
model_scope: Normal scope cancellation may instead drain an already accepted whole record to true numeric result/S ACK, then flush only unissued planned references. Raw mid-record abort recovery uses this separate full-identity path.
remaining: Production P executor must wire the true verified M ABORT/EOP plus global DMA CLOSE/return drain to this API; the unit fixture's proof does not satisfy that integration requirement.
